audience: F1 fans, and anyone who knows a few drivers
summary: Countries are easy to guess even without following F1, and the reveal has good moments: Finland at #6, Argentina (Fangio) at #10, Spain only #11. A solid, gettable daily.
reasons: Casual found 9/10 but spent all 5 lives on Spain, USA, Mexico, Monaco and Japan, all plausible and mostly near misses (Spain #11, USA #12).
Totals check out by driver (Prost, Senna, Lauda, Fangio, Häkkinen and Räikkönen) and are current mid-2026; the US count includes the 1950-60 Indy 500, as Wikipedia does.
Only 23 countries have a win, so it is not Blitz-ready.
fixes: Typing 'british' (natural for driver nationality) offers British Indian Ocean Territory / British Virgin Islands instead of United Kingdom; add 'British' as a United Kingdom alias.
Drop the junk alias 'Swedish sin' from Sweden (#15).
